# Best noise-cancelling headphones under $200

**Best overall ANC: JBL Live 780NC.** RTINGS ranks it the best under $200. Its ANC rivals Sony and Bose flagships, and it gets 60 hours of battery, multipoint, and LDAC. The downsides are high clamping force and a mediocre mic. RTINGS says it only sometimes sells just under $200, so check the current price. [RTINGS review and retailer links](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/noise-cancelling-headphones-under-200)

**Best value: Soundcore Space One, $99.99 ($80 with code AFSC20).** It has adaptive ANC, 40 hours of battery with ANC on, and LDAC on Android. It isn't built for workouts. [Buy via Dealectric (affiliate link)](https://dealectric.com/go/soundcore-space-one)

**Best budget all-rounder: Anker Soundcore Space Q45, around $100.** RTINGS calls it the best headphones under $200 overall. It has excellent noise isolation and about 28 hours of battery. It has a slight hiss with ANC on, and some owners report headband or hinge breakage. [RTINGS review and retailer links](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/by-price/under-200)

**Best for sound: Sennheiser Accentum Plus.** It has warm, balanced tuning, a parametric EQ, and 56 hours of battery. Its ANC is weaker than the others, and it's less comfortable on larger heads. [RTINGS review and retailer links](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/by-price/under-200)

**Best for calls: Sony ULT WEAR.** RTINGS rates its ANC as excellent. SoundGuys, via [RatingMobile](https://ratingmobile.com/articles/en/best-noise-cancelling-headphones-under-200), measured over 25 dB of attenuation above 80 Hz, with multipoint and LDAC. It was listed at $200 in March, so it may be at the edge of your budget.

**Other options:**
- **Soundcore Space One Pro, $199.99 ($160 with AFSC20):** It has 6 mics, 40 hours of battery with ANC on, and a fold-flat design. Tom's Guide calls it best under $200. [Buy via Dealectric (affiliate link)](https://dealectric.com/go/soundcore-space-one-pro)
- **Sony WH-CH730N, about $176–179:** Tom's Guide praises its ANC, comfort, and battery, but finds the U.S. price high. [Tom's Guide review](https://www.tomsguide.com/audio/headphones/sony-wh-ch730n-review)
- **JLab JBuds Lux ANC, about $80:** It has the weakest ANC of these but good battery life. [Tom's Guide list](https://www.tomsguide.com/us/best-noise-cancelling-headphones%2Creview-5566.html)

**My pick:** For the strongest ANC, get the JBL Live 780NC if you find it under $200. For the best price-to-performance, get the Space One at about $80 with the code.

**Caveats:**
- The Dealectric links are affiliate links, and the AFSC20 code (expires 2026-12-31) doesn't stack with sale prices.
- I can't browse, so I couldn't confirm live prices or get direct retailer links for the JBL, Q45, Sennheiser, and Sony. The RTINGS pages link to Amazon, Best Buy, and others.
- Some prices come from SoundGuys' March 2026 list, so check current prices before buying.
